tools.name: about
tools.description: What Golden Kog does and never does, its prices (set by the Kognai CFO) and how to pay. Free.

tools.name: resolve_ticker
tools.description: The Solana tokens that carry a ticker such as WIF or $WIF, side by side: symbol, name, mint, total liquidity in USD, pool count, age, and verified true when the mint is on Jupiter verified list; verified first, then liquidity. Candidates only: Golden Kog never picks one and never analyses a ticker.

tools.name: analyze_token
tools.description: One token risk and structure analysis: risk level and points from a published rule table (a regulated issuer's asset, such as USDC or an xStock, is ISSUER CONTROLLED: its issuer powers listed as expected controls with the issuer named, not as points), every flag with its evidence, the measured facts

tools.name: monitor_token
tools.description: Watches one token for a window with risk alerts (dev wallet sells, a top holder sells a large share, liquidity pulled, authorities changed, a new wallet cluster), by webhook or by polling get_job. The window on sale is 24 hours. Paid: partner key or x402.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: A job by its id with the view token from the paid reply: its state, report and alerts. Free.
